name: Unstable Fiendflame Cage AP OLD
description: The Fiendflame Cage is uncontrolled, releasing holy light and hellfire in the area.
disable: DC 48 Arcana , DC 48 Nature , DC 48 Occultism , or DC 48 Religion (master) four times on the Fiendflame Cage to calm it through ritual incantations
routine: (2 actions) On its initiative, the Fiendflame Cage uses 1 action to release a wave of hellfire, dealing (2d10+12) Spirit Damage|traits:unholy]{2d10+12 spirit damage and 2d10+12 fire damage} to all creatures in a 15-foot-radius burst (Basic DC 47 Reflex Saving Throw). The Fiendflame Cage uses its second action to release a wave of holy light, dealing (2d10+12) Spirit Damage|traits:holy]{2d10+12 spirit damage and 2d10+12 fire damage} to all creatures in a 15-foot-radius burst (Basic DC 47 Reflex Saving Throw).
